name: shopwork
description: A framework for your e-commerce needs.

scripts.start:all:dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "USER,PROD,CATL,CART,ORDR,PAYM,SHIP,MAIL,REVW,GTWY" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:product" "npm run start:catalog" "npm run start:cart" "npm run start:order" "npm run start:payment" "npm run start:shipping" "npm run start:mail" "npm run start:review" "npm run start:dev"
scripts.start:services: concurrently --kill-others --names "USER,PROD,CATL,CART,ORDR,PAYM,SHIP,MAIL,REVW" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:product" "npm run start:catalog" "npm run start:cart" "npm run start:order" "npm run start:payment" "npm run start:shipping" "npm run start:mail" "npm run start:review"
scripts.start:user: cross-env PORT=3001 ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.services.json src/user-service/main.ts
scripts.start:product: cross-env PORT=3002 ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.services.json src/services/product-service.ts
scripts.start:catalog: cross-env PORT=3003 ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.services.json src/services/catalog-service.ts
scripts.start:cart: cross-env PORT=3004 ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.services.json src/services/cart-service.ts
scripts.start:order: cross-env PORT=3005 ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.services.json src/services/order-service.ts
scripts.start:payment: cross-env PORT=3006 ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.services.json src/services/payment-service.ts
scripts.start:shipping: cross-env PORT=3007 ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.services.json src/services/shipping-service.ts
scripts.start:mail: cross-env PORT=3008 ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.services.json src/services/mail-service.ts
scripts.start:review: cross-env PORT=3009 ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register --project tsconfig.services.json src/services/review-service.ts
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --schema=./prisma/schema/schema.prisma --force && npm run db:seed
